title: Veggie Burrito Bowls
steps:
Cook the rice.
Stir in lime juice
+ cilantro

Warm beans with cumin.
Char the corn in a
dry skillet, 5-6 min

Set out lettuce,
avocado, cheese + salsa.
Build your own bowl
vo: Vegetarian burrito bowls, and everybody builds their own.
You need rice, two cans of black beans, frozen corn, avocados, lettuce, salsa, cheddar and limes.
Cook the rice, then stir in lime juice and chopped cilantro.
Warm the black beans with cumin, and char the corn in a dry skillet until it's spotty brown.
Set out lettuce, avocado, cheese and salsa, and let everyone build their own bowl.
